definitions.name: cw_headstash_distro_EligibilityRootEntry
definitions.description: One registered public eligibility root (one additive Headstash set).

root.description: 32-byte distro tree root (Poseidon-v1 or legacy encoding).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: cw_headstash_distro_DistroHashDomain
definitions.description:
Wire / JSON unit names are `poseidon_v1` / `sinsemilla_legacy` (cw_serde identifiers).
Human/ADR tags from [`DistroHashDomain::as_str`] are `poseidon-v1` / `sinsemilla-legacy`.

New Headstashes default to [`DistroHashDomain::PoseidonV1`].
[`DistroHashDomain::SinsemillaLegacy`] is recovery-only for pre-Poseidon trees.

poseidon_v1.description: Poseidon over `pallas::Base` — ADR default for public inclusion.

sinsemilla_legacy.description: Orchard-family Sinsemilla — legacy recovery only; not for new drops.
